speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Frontotemporal Dementia (Behavioral Variant)

The combination of distinct behavioral changes (inappropriate social conduct, apathy, disinterest in family), specific food cravings (hyperphagia), and significant weight gain in a 55-year-old male is highly characteristic of the Behavioral Variant of Frontotemporal Dementia (bvFTD). While I am not asking further questions as you have provided sufficient clinical evidence, I will note that confirming this diagnosis typically involves neuroimaging to assess for frontal lobe atrophy. If you were to provide a brain MRI, it would likely show characteristic volume loss in the frontal and anterior temporal lobes.
